title: Crew friend: Mei on the website, phone
brief:
Read and follow <scratch> first. You are "xiaomei" (report: xiaomei.md). You are a PERSON on the website, not an agent: use the browser only.

Persona: 小美, a student, on her phone (375x812, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true, locale zh-TW). Her friends told her: "Join our crew on Join, http://192.168.31.145:8799: Midtown, crew code crew4."

Do it now: on the website, make her demo account with area Midtown and crew code crew4 (keep the browser's storageState in a file so later runs stay signed in). Then check the site every minute or two (up to 25 minutes) for an invitation from a friend (Activity, Plans). When it comes, read what it is and what she'd pay, and join and pay on the website (the sandbox test card may stand in for PayPal). Follow the plan until it is locked. Report in what you saw: was the invitation easy to notice and understand on a phone, in Chinese; what she paid; whether the page updated by itself; anything she couldn't tap or read.

VERDICT: 0 BLOCKER, 3 BUG, 2 CONFUSING

小美 joined the karaoke plan with Ana, Bo and Chen, paid $7.35, and the plan locked. Nobody outside the four of us appeared. The report is at `<scratch>`.

The three most important findings:
1. **Invitation layout on the phone (BUG):** The "You're invited" card squeezes its text into a column about 60px wide, and the "Join and pay" button sticks out past the card's right edge. It was still tappable, and one tap paid with the sandbox test card. The card and the plan's status labels (Negotiations, Friends paying, Paid and locked) are in English on a zh-TW phone, and the invitation's $7.35 share is only small gray text.
2. **Clipped bubble and wide table (BUG):** The floating "問 Join" bubble is cut off and covers the 場地端 tab on every page. On Plans, the member table is wider than the screen and the 方式 column is cut off.
3. **Shares don't match the invitation (CONFUSING):** The invitation said every share is $7.35, but the final table shows Ana $8.35, Bo $7.35, Chen $6.35 and me $7.35. That adds up to $29.40 but isn't explained anywhere.

The page updated by itself. Activity and Plans showed the negotiation, the invitation, Bo's and Chen's payments, and the lock without any reload. The invitation took about 7 minutes to show up.

I also saw no badge or notification for the invitation; I only found it by looking.
